newsitem.title: USA: INSIGHT - Can$ hits two-yr low, eyes record bottom. [CORRECTED 00:20 GMT 4/4]
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - Can$ hits two-yr low, eyes record bottom. [CORRECTED 00:20 GMT 4/4]

text.p: (Corrects headline to read "two-yr low" rather than "two-yr high")

The dollar appeared headed for a close above Canadian $1.39 for the first time in nearly two years on Thursday and could revisit record highs if it holds above C$1.3780 in the near term, U.S. chartists said.
The slumping Canadian unit pulled the greenback above the big February 1996 top of C$1.3865 on Tuesday and hit a peak of C$1.3926, its highest since early April 1995, on Thursday.

"There was a (Canadian dollar) double bottom that broke at C$1.3780, this has an objective of basically C$1.42 to C$1.4250, a retest of the (dollar) highs," said Thom Worden, global technical analyst at Deutsche Morgan Grenfell.
